title: a 65th unanswered CALL on a DEFAULT link (limit 64)
notes: 02-4: exceeding the outstanding-CALL limit returns RESOURCE_LIMIT and must not block waiting for a free slot.
precondition: 64 CALL transactions are already unanswered on this endpoint (A20_LIMIT_CLX_INFLIGHT_DEFAULT)
followup: tx_drops += 1 and the new call returns A20_ERR_NO_SPACE(13) (01-abi maps A20_ERR_RESOURCE_LIMIT to A20_ERR_NO_SPACE); no frame is ever built
